title.zh: 【币安在阿联酋推出 bStocks，首批包括 Circle、英伟达、特斯拉等】
title.en: 【币安在阿联酋推出 bStocks，首批包括 Circle、英伟达、特斯拉等】

current_state.zh: Binance bStocks 在上线后用户持仓金额突破 10 亿美元，累计交易量超过 400 亿美元，日均交易量超过 3 亿美元，上线资产接近 100 种，并支持 1:1 转换、符合条件场景下用作抵押品、全天候交易、链上结算及钱包间转移。
current_state.en: After launch, Binance bStocks has surpassed $1 billion in user AUM, over $40 billion cumulative trading volume, over $300 million average daily volume, nearly 100 listed assets, and supports 1:1 conversions, use as collateral in eligible cases, 24/7 trading, on-chain settlement, and wallet-to-wallet transfers.

updates.title_zh: 【币安在阿联酋推出 bStocks，首批包括 Circle、英伟达、特斯拉等】
updates.title_en: 【币安在阿联酋推出 bStocks，首批包括 Circle、英伟达、特斯拉等】
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安面向符合条件的阿联酋用户推出bStocks代币化证券产品，首批提供对Circle、Nvidia、Micron、SanDisk和Tesla股票价格的代币化追踪敞口，由关联公司BTech Holdings发行，最低5美元，支持24/7交易和BNB Chain自托管。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance launched its bStocks tokenized securities product for eligible UAE users, debuting with tokenized price-tracking exposure to Circle, Nvidia, Micron, SanDisk and Tesla stocks, issued by affiliate BTech Holdings with $5 minimums, 24/7 trading and BNB Chain self-custody support.

updates.title_zh: 【币安 bStocks 用户持仓金额突破 10 亿美元，累计交易量超 400 亿美元】
updates.title_en: 【币安 bStocks 用户持仓金额突破 10 亿美元，累计交易量超 400 亿美元】
updates.what_changed_zh: bStocks 用户持仓金额突破 10 亿美元，累计交易量超过 400 亿美元，日均交易量超过 3 亿美元，上线资产接近 100 种，自上线以来直接持股与 bStocks 的 1:1 转换规模达 60 亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: bStocks surpassed $1 billion in user AUM, cumulative trading volume above $40 billion, average daily volume over $300 million, nearly 100 listed assets, and about $6 billion in 1:1 conversions between directly held shares and bStocks since launch.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance bStocks 在上线后用户持仓金额突破 10 亿美元，累计交易量超过 400 亿美元，日均交易量超过 3 亿美元，上线资产接近 100 种，并支持 1:1 转换、符合条件场景下用作抵押品、全天候交易、链上结算及钱包间转移。
updates.current_state_en: After launch, Binance bStocks has surpassed $1 billion in user AUM, over $40 billion cumulative trading volume, over $300 million average daily volume, nearly 100 listed assets, and supports 1:1 conversions, use as collateral in eligible cases, 24/7 trading, on-chain settlement, and wallet-to-wallet transfers.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance announced that its tokenized stock product bStocks has passed $1 billion in assets held by users, with cumulative trading volume above $40 billion and roughly $6 billion of 1:1 conversions between directly held shares and tokens since its June 11, 2026 launch.
